name: Hunted
source:
Lilian, a hunter in 20XX, grew up on warnings: vampires are dangerous, keep away. Peace treaties made hunting mostly obsolete, but the prejudice remains. 

One impulsive message on a dating app leads to months of talks, and now a meeting that may prove your family wrong.

[From [url=https://rafaanimations.itch.io/hunted]Itch.io[/url]]
